findings.title: Fixed radial shrink discards an exactly representable witness in a one-ulp overlapping lens
findings.impact: The required finite easy-case execution fails with NUMERICAL_FAILURE even for an identically zero response and zero objective. This is a candidate-construction defect; no false scientific rejection or invalid accepted witness was observed.
findings.cause: The physical-ball radial proposal is multiplied by 1-16*eps before the unshrunk boundary point is tested. This moves farther than the overlap width and outside the direct ball. The zero-response path returns this absent anchor, and the certificate fallback repeats it before claiming no representable witness.
findings.exact_oracle: center=(1/4-2^-55,0,0), e_d=Dmax=1/8; witness=(1/8,0,0). Direct squared slack is 2^-57-2^-110>0, physical squared slack is zero. With S=O=0 its residual is exactly zero and is strictly below B=.001.

findings.recommendation: Try exact-verified unshrunk radial/boundary candidates before an inward adjustment; any adjustment must retain both original-ball memberships.
